title: Nine Minutes of Filming
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（文学艺术与体育·节日与庆典）　|　核心词汇：ceremony　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ceremony 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my mother was sent to film ① ceremony she could not enter, and she said the filming was the whole of the lesson. The ② ceremony, meaning the event and not the custom, was nine minutes long and was filmed by whoever came last; ceremony, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ ceremony in that town had the same song, and the ④ ceremony at the end, meaning the one the elders kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever filmed properly. Ceremony, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ ceremony was the whole of the year, meaning the custom it carried and not the event. The ⑥ ceremony, meaning the custom and not any of that, is the only thing in a year that everybody attends and nobody questions; ceremony, he said, is either something you film or the only word that means both an event and a custom. She said the custom is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ ceremony had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the song. The ⑧ ceremony of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine minutes and eleven years of filming; ceremony, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ceremony I remember is the one at the end, which was filmed in 1972 and is still described as the finest in the county. A ⑩ ceremony, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being filmed; every ceremony, she said, is a custom that has agreed to look like an event. She said the custom was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 仪式（指那场活动本身，与那个习俗相对）
C. 固定搭配：film a ceremony 拍摄一场仪式
D. n. 仪式（指镇上每一场）
E. n. 仪式（指末尾那一场）
F. n. 礼俗（抽象：它承载的那个习俗）
G. n. 那个习俗（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The ceremony, meaning the event and not the custom
ceremony was the whole of the year
the ceremony had become a number in a report
The ceremony of the whole thing
A ceremony, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: film a ceremony 意为“拍摄一场仪式”，1954 年母亲被派去拍摄她进不去的那场仪式。
ceremony 意为“仪式、典礼”，指那场活动本身而不是那个习俗，长九分钟，由最后来的人拍摄。
ceremony 指镇上每一场仪式，每一场都是同样的歌。
ceremony 指末尾那一场（长者保留的那一场），是唯一有人认真拍摄过的。
ceremony 意为“礼俗”，抽象指它承载的那个习俗，父亲说 ceremony 就是那一年的全部。
ceremony 为抽象用法，指那个习俗本身，是一年里人人都参加、却没人质疑的东西。
ceremony 意为“仪式、典礼”，到 1967 年这场 ceremony 成了报告里的一个数字。
ceremony 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九分钟和十一年的拍摄。
ceremony 意为“仪式”，我记得的是末尾那一场，1972 年拍过，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
ceremony 为抽象总称，祖母说一场仪式是唯一会因为被认真拍摄而变好的东西。
